# ADR-026 — Provider-agnostic AI layer over user-supplied, DB-stored, encrypted API keys; no hardcoded provider, no silent fallback

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Provider-agnostic AI layer: Vercel AI SDK abstraction (`packages/ai-providers`) over user-supplied, DB-stored, encrypted-at-rest API keys — no LLM provider hardcoded, no per-vendor env vars, no silent fallback to an unconfigured provider (user-approved 2026-08-15)
